title: 45. Balancing Your Life feat. Abbie Stasior
description_html: This week I'm joined by Abbie Stasior (@abbie.stasior on Instagram). Abbie is a health and life coach, graduate student at Columbia University, and the founder of Be About Being Better.
talk_about: Abbie's approach to balancing grad school, owning a business, and maintaining her physical health
Her career path to being a life and fitness coach
Morning and night routines to set you up for success
Falling off the wagon vs. being consistent
guests: abbie stasior, health and life coach
summary: sadie sits down with abbie stasior, a health and life coach, columbia grad student, and founder of be about being better. they talk through abbie's approach to juggling school, business, and her own physical health without burning out. abbie shares her journey to becoming a life and fitness coach, plus the morning and night routines that actually help her stay grounded. they also get real about what it means to fall off the wagon versus building true consistency in your life.
quote: self-care is not selfish. self-care is self-centered.
quote_display: self-care is not SELFISH. self-care is SELF-CENTERED.
